login.note: Note: Login only grants access to your Yuketang session for monitoring. All user data, session information, and keys are stored locally on your device only.
login.pwFillAll: Please enter phone number and password

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noActivity: No activity yet. Events will appear here when a class starts.
dashboard.qrCheckinDesc: Paste a Yuketang dynamic QR value. The server validates it before entering the classroom. This flow always uses QR source 21.
dashboard.qrPlaceholder: Paste the QR link or content
dashboard.qrSuccess: Checked in and connected to the classroom
dashboard.qrAlreadyRunning: This classroom is already running; reused the existing connection
dashboard.qrEmpty: Enter a QR link or value
dashboard.monitorSettingsDesc: Configure automatic check-in and AI answering for the current account. Changes apply immediately.
dashboard.checkinSourceDesc: The source type used when automatically entering a classroom.
dashboard.autoCheckinDesc: When off, new classrooms are not entered automatically; manual QR check-in remains available.
dashboard.aiAnsweringDesc: Controls every course: AI uses DeepSeek, Random follows the question-type policy, and Off skips answering; random fallback submits automatically when nobody responds in the final 5 seconds.
dashboard.clearActivityConfirm: Clear recent activity for the current account?
dashboard.answerReviewNoText: Question text was not returned; refer to the screenshot above.
dashboard.answerReviewOff: Global answer mode is off; this question will not be submitted.

settings.title: Course Settings
settings.deepseekApiKeyDesc: Enter only your DeepSeek API Key. Saving it automatically enables the DeepSeek vision model for AI answers.
settings.fallbackKeysDesc: When the active key fails, try other keys in order

answerLast5sTable.title: Submission timing: 8 combinations
answerLast5sTable.aiOnLimited: Wait for AI until the last 1–5s window; confirm to submit, or auto-submit a random answer in the final 5s
answerLast5sTable.aiOnUnlimited: Wait for AI and confirm in the dashboard; auto-submit a random answer in the final 5s if nobody responds
answerLast5sTable.aiOffLimited: Show the AI answer for confirmation; confirm to submit, or auto-submit a random answer in the final 5s
answerLast5sTable.aiOffUnlimited: Wait for AI and confirm in the dashboard; auto-submit a random answer in the final 5s if nobody responds
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOnLimited: Show the random answer for confirmation; confirm or auto-submit it in the final 5s
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOnUnlimited: Show the random answer for confirmation; confirm or auto-submit it in the final 5s
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOffLimited: Show the random answer for confirmation; confirm or auto-submit it in the final 5s
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOffUnlimited: Show the random answer for confirmation; confirm or auto-submit it in the final 5s

settings.pushdeerEndpointHint: Defaults to the official api2.pushdeer.com. Self-hosted users can enter a private endpoint. Get your Key from the PushDeer app.
settings.courseEnabledDesc: When off, this course is ignored entirely (no sign-in, no quiz answering, no danmu, no notifications).
settings.pollIntervalDesc: How often to check Yuketang for active lessons. Allowed: {{min}}–{{max}}s (default {{default}}s). Lower = faster lesson detection but more API requests.
settings.checkinDelayDesc: How long to wait after discovering a new classroom before checking in. Range: {{min}}–{{max}} seconds; default {{default}}. 0 means immediately.
settings.checkinSourceDesc: This value identifies the entry source sent to the classroom API. Behavior can differ by school or Yuketang version. QR code (21) is recommended by default. These values are observed in public clients/community projects, not an official API enum.
settings.checkinSourceCourseDesc: Inherit the account default or override the entry source for this course.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.confirmDelete: Delete this account? All its settings, courses and keys will be erased.

events.ai_failed: AI answering failed; switched to a random answer and waiting for confirmation; auto-submit runs in the final 5 seconds if nobody responds

common.betaWarning: AI answer accuracy is not guaranteed. If no key is configured, random answering is used as fallback.
